name: Rug, IKEA HJORTSVANG 160 × 230
notes: IKEA HJORTSVANG rug, handmade, off-white, 160 × 230 cm, article 804.425.27 (IKEA Switzerland): 160 wide, 230 long, 2.7 cm thick in all. The surface is 100 % wool, undyed (its natural colour), on a warp and weft of 100 % cotton; handwoven and flatwoven, on a pit loom, so each one differs a little. It is thick wool braided in rows across its width, with narrow woven edges and no fringe. The default finish, rug.hjortsvang-off-white, draws the braids up to the edges: a texture generated by `python tools/textures/rug-hjortsvang.py` (no photo in it), its rows 3.6 cm apart as on IKEA's photos, running across the rug. The other rug colorways and fabrics can be picked to try a colour, but they are planning recolours, plain or patterned, not HJORTSVANG versions: IKEA makes it only in off-white. Furniture can stand on it: it takes no part in collision checks.
